digest.summary: The Hacker News discussion highlights the ongoing tension between AI capabilities and responsible deployment across major AI companies.

stories.headline: OpenAI Restricts Cyber Model Access After Criticizing Anthropic's Mythos Limitations
stories.summary: OpenAI has restricted access to its Cyber model, creating an ironic situation after the company previously criticized Anthropic for implementing similar access limitations on its Mythos model [1]. The move has sparked significant discussion in the AI community about consistency in AI safety policies.
key_points: OpenAI's decision mirrors the same type of access restrictions it criticized Anthropic for implementing
The situation highlights ongoing debates about balancing AI capabilities with responsible deployment
stories.perspectives: The Hacker News community discussion reveals mixed reactions, with some pointing out the hypocrisy while others defend the need for cautious AI deployment regardless of previous statements.
stories.impact: This development affects the broader AI policy landscape, particularly for organizations evaluating different AI providers' commitment to consistent safety standards and access policies.

sources.title: After dissing Anthropic for limiting Mythos, OpenAI restricts access to Cyber

stories.headline: New AI CAD Harness Tool Launches for Design Workflows
stories.summary: A new AI-powered CAD harness tool has been released, garnering attention from the developer community with 82 points and 85 comments on Hacker News [1]. The tool appears to integrate AI capabilities into computer-aided design workflows.
stories.impact: This tool could benefit engineers and designers looking to incorporate AI assistance into their CAD workflows, particularly those working with design automation and parametric modeling.

stories.headline: Use environment variables to configure MCP server settings in Claude Code
stories.summary: Claude Code v2.1.85 introduced CLAUDE_CODE_MCP_SERVER_NAME and CLAUDE_CODE_MCP_SERVER_URL environment variables for MCP headersHelper scripts. This allows a single helper script to serve multiple MCP servers, simplifying configuration management.
actionable_steps: Set the CLAUDE_CODE_MCP_SERVER_NAME environment variable to your desired server name
Set the CLAUDE_CODE_MCP_SERVER_URL environment variable to your MCP server URL
Update your MCP headersHelper scripts to use these variables instead of hardcoded values

stories.headline: Enable forked subagents in external Claude Code builds
stories.summary: Forked subagents allow Claude Code to spawn separate agent processes for parallel task execution. This can improve performance for complex workflows that benefit from concurrent processing.
actionable_steps: Restart Claude Code to apply the setting
Verify subagents are working by checking for multiple agent processes during complex tasks

stories.headline: Configure persistent Claude Code settings using ~/.claude/settings.json
stories.summary: Claude Code now saves your /config preferences (theme, editor mode, verbose output) to a persistent file instead of resetting each session. This eliminates the need to reconfigure your preferences every time you start Claude Code.
actionable_steps: Run Claude Code and use /config to set your preferred theme, editor mode, and other settings
Verify settings are saved to ~/.claude/settings.json file
Test persistence by restarting Claude Code and confirming settings remain

stories.headline: Use @-mentions to give Claude Code precise file context
stories.summary: Boris Cherny, creator of Claude Code, recommends using @-mentions to point Claude at specific files instead of letting it search. This dramatically reduces token usage and improves accuracy since Claude works with the exact files you intend rather than guessing from project structure.
actionable_steps: Type @ in Claude Code to see a file picker with fuzzy search
Select the specific files relevant to your task before writing your prompt
Combine multiple @-mentions for cross-file tasks like refactoring

stories.headline: Add session tracking header for proxy aggregation
stories.summary: Use the `X-Claude-Code-Session-Id` header in your API requests to help proxies group requests by session without needing to parse request bodies. This improves routing and monitoring capabilities when using Claude Code through proxy servers.
actionable_steps: Add the `X-Claude-Code-Session-Id` header to your Claude Code API requests
Set the header value to your session identifier
Configure your proxy to use this header for request aggregation instead of body parsing
